title: Geometry: Basics of Geometry
description: Lesson sheet for the Basics of Geometry unit, from line segments through diagrams, with a short algebra-review warm-up and the first parallel-lines skill at the high end. Easy to hard.

ramp.label: Level 1
ramp.description: Most items at low D with a gentle ramp.
